english.title: Contravene a prohibition on excluded traffic in the Kingsway Tunnels

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9 and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used a handcart / mailcart / metal-tyred vehicle / perambulator / push-cart /
wheelbarrow / pedal cycle/ vehicles drawn by animals
in the Kingsway tunnels / the approaches OR
permitted an animal to enter the Kingsway tunnels

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Byelaw 9 states, (in part), ;-

9(d) Handcarts, mailcarts, metal-tyred vehicles, perambulators, pushcarts, wheelbarrows, pedal cycles and vehicles drawn by animals shall not be used in the Kingsway tunnels or on the approaches thereto.

9(e) No person shall permit any animal to enter the tunnels except animals conveyed in a vehicle.
